description: Removes the watermark from a finished file that has a cuttingfloor watermark (watermarked: true on its export result, media.get or media.list), spending its release_credits (priced by length) once from the user's credits. Afterwards every link to it (url, page_url, media.get) serves the clean file, and this returns fresh ones. Tell the user the price and get their go-ahead first. Releasing again, or a file that never had the watermark, spends nothing. Not enough credits: quota_exceeded, and the watermarked file still downloads.

job_id.description: An export.video job, or the create.* job that made a media

media_id.description: A media made by an export, a create.* tool or a still: removes the watermark from its own file

name: export.release

balance.description: Credits left after it; null on a plan with no cap, and on a server you run

credits.description: Credits this call spent: 0 when the file was already released or never marked

anyOf.description: Job handle; the same value is the MCP task id

job_id.description: The job whose file was released; null for a still

media_id.description: The media, when one was named

page_url.description: A page that plays the clean file in any browser

price.description: What removing the watermark costs; 0 for a file that never has one

url.description: Signed download of the clean file

title: Remove watermark
